name: Osa-AK: a low flier, angles by the TV and the range by the radar alone (EM radars; the NPC commander runs the crew)
description: A fictional practice shoot against a drone that comes in at 40 m (roadmap 6.6, 9.1). The crew locks it with the tracking radar at 15 km, but as it closes the echo sinks into the ground and the lock breaks: НЛЦ lights. The commander sends the TV along the azimuth line (Низколетящая! Углы — по ТВ!) and, once the TV holds it, has the operator range on it with the radar alone (Полуавтомат!). At 125 s the drone's noise pod comes on and drowns the echo: the range-only radar has nothing to range on, and the range is the deputy's from the target's size in the TV. Take any seat.
notes: Fictional. Flat plain. The drone, its 40 m height and its noise pod (generic_selfscreen_noise_ku in data/em/generic.json) are PLACEHOLDERS. The drills: track_low_target and track_range_semi_auto (samsim_osa p25-26).

jammers.notes: A self-screening noise pod against the tracking radar, switched on as the drone closes.
